name: connected accounts list with karma meter bars
looks: A short list of small avatar rows, each with a username, grows a horizontal meter bar beside it that fills to a different length, landing on a small number label at the end of each bar.
build: data-infographic's bar-growth pattern, horizontal instead of vertical: each bar's scaleX animates 0 -> 1 from a left origin on an uneven stagger, the number ticking up as the bar fills.
sound: A soft tick per bar as it finishes filling.
prompt: List a handful of small identity rows, each gaining a horizontal meter bar that fills to its own length a beat apart, with a number counting up as it fills. Use it to show several independent accounts or agents building up activity at once.
